title: Lecture 6: Stages of building LLM
diagram_summary: A flowchart showing the stages of building a Large Language Model (LLM), progressing from Stage 1 (Attention mechanism and LLM architecture, building on pretraining) through Stage 2 (Training loop, Model evaluation, Load pretrained weights) to Stage 3 (Finetuning and Classification), with foundational model as the central component.
